Everyone will then say that the platinum crisis took everyone by surprise and could not have been predicted... Yeah, right.
sources.669fa39ee749756c920d02c8 successMessageT: Excellent! I've already found a specialist to look into this subject. Your contribution to the safety of the city is invaluable!
sources.669fa3a08b4a64b332041ff7 successMessageT: You're a good kid. My comrade will find a good stash spot for this thingie where no one will ever find it.
sources.669fa3a1c26f13bd04030f37 successMessageT: Is everything working now? Great, I'll pass the news on to my, uh, mechanics.
sources.669fa3a3ad7f1eac2607ed48 successMessageT: Do you have the samples? All right, let's carefully move them over here... There seems to be no connection to epidemiological risks. But the blood texture is quite different than expected, so this must be somehow influenced by TerraGroup!
sources.66a1a806bd092031693a6e25 successMessageT: I knew I could count on you. You saved the city from another conflict. We shouldn't be digging into the shady dealings of these "scientists", nothing good comes out of it.
sources.66a74c628410476dd65543be successMessageT: Many thanks. I think this will keep me on track for some time.
sources.66a75b44243a6548ff5e5ff9 successMessageT: Hmm, I see. Pretty much what I expected, of course. Yet I still need more feedback... Anyway, I'll be in touch.
sources.66a77394243a6548ff5e601d successMessageT: Excellent, I'll never forget this! I'll send your colleagues to fix my cables. Things are getting better, aren't they? Here, another present for you.
sources.66a78dada472ad7f845b71f7 successMessageT: Thank you, man. Stay in touch.
sources.66aa58245ab22944110db6e9 successMessageT:
Amazing, you've found it! Hopefully it'll be just as safe by the time the convoy leaves.

However, I don't understand how they were able to restore the road. The road was blocked by the collapsed Paradigm Shipping building, which is when supplies were cut off. Few people have the resources to clear such a wreck.

Apparently, someone is very interested in organizing easy routes...
sources.66aa61663aa37705c5024277 successMessageT: I think we got the wrong guys, man. Someone came by and told me that this route is used by some very important people. Should've thought this through...
sources.66aa74571e5e199ecd094f18 successMessageT: You didn't lose anything along the way, correct? All right, then it's time to send the engineers out to do some measurements, we're about to find out what these factory walls are hiding. Thanks for your help, friend.
sources.66ab970848ddbe9d4a0c49a8 successMessageT:
Your country will be proud of you, soldier! 

But the fact that the Scavs started roaming around this path worries me a bit... Someone must be scouting for all the forgotten shortcut routes on Tarkov's map.
sources.66ab9da7eb102b9bcd08591c successMessageT:
The forest likes quiet, we can't let them destroy such places. 

I don't know how they could have found out about this trail... My friend has never shown his paths to bad people.
sources.66aba85403e0ee3101042877 successMessageT: So you have found it indeed. Excellent! How's the passage, is it safe? In a state of disrepair, you say? Well, it seems like this opportunity won't be with us for long. I'll send my men as soon as possible.
sources.66abb019f5ca239a1006258b successMessageT: You done with the sightseeing? Fucking great, mate! Oh, by the way... Is it true what they say about this mushroom picker wandering through the swamp at night?
sources.66abb32aeb102b9bcd088d5f successMessageT: The buyer has told me everything is in place. You've earned your reward, and you can expect my men to help you on the new trails.
sources.66b38c7bf85b8bf7250f9cb6 successMessageT: Would you look at that, you're alive! While you were gone, I've prepped this little thingie for you, so you can learn the secrets of booby trapping on your own. Consider it a homework assignment, but just make sure to not blow yourself up.
sources.66b38e144f2ab7cc530c3fe7 successMessageT:
Good job, you found some decent spots. Tripwires demand a specific approach, and now you're starting to get the hang of it. Come back if you need another tripwire kit.

Be careful, though! You're not the only one who knows how to set a tripwire, which means every bush, every room, and every rock can kill you. Remember that well.
sources.66d9cbb67b491f9d5304f6e6 successMessageT:
Well would you look at this. The customer is very pleased with the material. He even said that he himself would fit in well with the local culture with his blades and pistols.

We really don't need any more katana lovers in leather suits around here... I hope his interest in Tarkov passes as quickly as it arose.
sources.66e01aca214f88109006a4b5 successMessageT:
Alive and well, that's great. So let's see what we're working with here. Somebody stole the mortars and now they're hitting various locations right before the airdrop supplies come in. 

Very suspicious. These local powdermen sure couldn't have secured communications with the outside world, could they? Either way, all we can do for now is watch.
sources.66e01ad15a8890455a0d9eea successMessageT:
Good work! Now, what do we have here? Bingo, It's radar parts. It'll come in handy in the future. I think I know who might be interested. 

What? You wanna know too? It's not a soldier's job to ask questions. On your way, merc.
sources.66e01ad6835f78499f049180 successMessageT: Splendid, the new toys have arrived. My guys are gonna love these. You need to be ready for anything these days, and such protection is definitely not superfluous.
sources.66e01adbd3d014f3ae061c12 successMessageT: Good, now that they're safe from airborne threats, their combat mission will be accomplished with no problem.
sources.66e01ae0c391e4c94903d220 successMessageT:
The task was difficult, but you did it perfectly, soldier! Now all that remains is to find out who brought such rare tools to Tarkov and for what purpose. But that's my concern, you don't need to get involved.

I've got a good reward for you. My guys intercepted some Scavs, they had some special RSP flares on them. Should be useful!
sources.66e01c4c475acf7e0102d296 successMessageT: I think we salvaged most of it, that's good. Now we wait.
sources.66e3e2ee2136472d220bcb36 successMessageT:
So, what'd you find? I didn't sit idle either while you were gone, I met with Partisan. He says they're preparing a special ritual, and that's why they're coming out of their dens. They're all mentioning some kind of “Night of The Cult”.

I don't know what's this about, but it's definitely bad news for Tarkov. And something tells me there's somebody who's orchestrating the whole thing. That demon didn't just show up in our parts for no reason. 

I saw something myself last night, though. His face was red, like it was burning. I grabbed my gun and aimed, but just as I blinked, there was no one there. Old man hallucinations, perhaps...
sources.66e3e2fcb26de0e0790d3fe6 successMessageT:
The bastards are taken care of? Damn things belong in hell anyway. Hopefully, the rest of the cultists will back off and go back to their dens. 

Funny thing is, Zryachiy's been absent lately, too. I wonder if he came down from the Lighthouse to finish the ritual and let those demons out into the light of day.
sources.66e3e3027804a21d860755d6 successMessageT:
Freeze, you vermin! Oh, it's you. They're starting to show up in my neck of the woods now, too. I've had a few of those visitors just before you.

You say you've cleansed Tarkov of the cultists? Well, with losses like that, they won't be able to do anything anytime soon. They'll forget all about the Harbinger. However, I don't know if I'll be able to sleep easy for a while.

Thanks for your help. Couldn't have done it without you.
sources.670404a2ea1caa8f2e0be106 successMessageT:
I cannot believe it! So the madman was telling the truth? If it's connected to TerraGroup and their experiments, it's bad news.

It seems that someone has opened the Lab from the inside, disrupted all the security, and now anyone can get in and out of there.

Take care of yourself and get ready for some serious footwork. Tarkov is in great danger.
sources.67040b3d10b18d153a08f636 successMessageT: Okay, good. I'm glad you're still in one piece. Don't get caught by those bastards, I still need your help.
sources.67040b6c45eaf70db10dbec6 successMessageT:
Oh, that's you. Are you absolutely certain you're not infected? They say the first symptom is itching and fever.

But if you've killed so many of them and haven't gotten sick yourself, then I'm sure you're still able to help. You can go for now, and I'll make some lemon tea with honey. To keep my immune system strong, you know?
sources.67040ba4578a46e44a05c0a8 successMessageT:
Only when you know what you're up against can you make an effective remedy.

But that will take time. The information that may have been stored on some TerraGroup devices would help speed up the process. 

I have contacted Mechanic. If he finds anything useful, he will contact you himself.
sources.67040c22cc1f3752720376e9 successMessageT:
Okay, I see the connection, so you did everything right... Oh, they're DDoS-proofed. But what if we access it from here, you assholes? Hm, that's where Mr. Kerman comes in.

Are you still here? I'm sorry, I don't have time to chitchat anymore. Kerman just sent over his data, said he's not gonna let TerraGroup's projects ruin our city. 

While he takes down the security, I have to format the drives to give Therapist everything we can find out.
sources.67040c43ce929d6ee506c7c7 successMessageT:
Good! I'll get to work right away and contact Mechanic. 

The diary is probably encrypted, so our friend's love of complex riddles will come in handy.
sources.67040c5b4ac6d9c18c0ade26 successMessageT:
Well done, kid! We're short of manpower right now, but together we're at least buying time to create a cure. 

And if we lose, at least we'll leave it cleaner. Just have to do what has to be done.
sources.67040c78bf4be8a4ef041a65 successMessageT:
Your contribution to saving the city is invaluable! However, I can't do a full analysis of the sample on my own.

But I know someone who can be involved in the process. An expert of the highest caliber... I will get back to you with the results very soon.
sources.67040c92bf4be8a4ef041a6c successMessageT:
Glad you're still with us. It's getting better, even if it's only for a short while. 

We can take a short break and regain our strength for now, as long as it's calm. Hopefully the medic hag will give us some results soon.
sources.67040cae4ac6d9c18c0ade2c failMessageText: How dare you! My colleague made a critical contribution to saving the city and did not deserve this fate! I don't know how I can trust you after such outrageous actions.
sources.67040cae4ac6d9c18c0ade2c successMessageT:
You made the right choice. I know Jaeger tried to trick you into harming my colleague.

The foreman's notes say that two delivery crews abandoned the boxes during transportation and flatly refused to continue their work!

sources.67a096577e86e067eb045733 successMessageT:
Why didn't I think of that before? Knossos didn't purchase the whole territory of Azure Coast, but only the basements under it! That's why I thought this playground was our target.

A door like this is unlikely to be accessed with a regular TerraGroup keycard. Considering they, meaning TerraGroup specifically, disguised that place as a Knossos facility, the keycard to access it should probably also have a suitable design.

I'll try to find out more about these keycards and secure access to them, but it will take a considerable amount of time. If you don't wanna wait, try to find some other useful information, or better yet, the keycards themselves.
sources.67a0966817e34930e500754c successMessageT: Excellent, now we have access to this facility. There's no time to lose. The rumor of the health resort cellars and the keycards has already spread throughout the city, and you may very well have competition on your tail. Gotta hurry up.
sources.67a09673972c11a3f507731d successMessageT:
Did he seriously transport the bodies of his victims along with the meat, which then went to the store shelves? That is appalling. The fact that you found this substance used by the maniac will help my colleague make progress on the... evidence file on this case.

Here are your keycards, I already received them. Along with them, I was asked to tell you to watch your step when visiting the basement. Apparently the cellars have deteriorated over the years.
sources.67a0967c003a9986cb0f5ac1 successMessageT:
So, did'ya deliver the bottle? Huh? Man, this driver guy's such a prick. I love him! Hey, easy there, man, I get it. Listen, some things just shouldn't be talked about right off the bat, the Labyrinth is one of them.

I have to consider all the risks that come with this info, so sit tight for a little while.
sources.67a096ed77dd677f600804ba successMessageT:
Are you sure this is it? Okay, I can smell it, that's definitely the one! 

Ragman told me about the health resort's cellars yesterday, I even had to fucking get him wasted so we could finally change the subject. Anyway, there was a Soviet bomb shelter under the health resort, and Ref was going to organize a new arena there, for VIP audiences. I think it also involved Tagilla somehow... No, it was something else...

Anyway, for this arena, Ref organized a big gear acquisition from Ragman, everything was almost ready. And then our host guy suddenly backed out. Why? Who the fuck knows.

Ragman was really upset that the idea had fallen through. But he'd already delivered some of the gear, and he definitely used those keycards you're looking for. You better ask him yourself, I don't remember much from yesterday. Thanks for the drink, by the way.
sources.67a096ed77dd677f600804ba acceptPlayerMes: You didn't make it to the "test sample" yesterday. Here, Ragman asked me to give it to you so that you could test it yourself.
sources.67a096ed77dd677f600804ba completePlayerM: By the way, I wanted to ask you: have you heard anything about the facility under the health resort and the keycards to access it?
sources.67a096f605d1611ed90be75a successMessageT:
Never doubted you, brotherman! Alright, time to do my part. One day, Ref came to me with an idea for a big project. He found these cellars under Azure Coast, he even had investors already. Even back then I already thought that somebody out there really liked the chaos we had going on here a little too much.

Everything went as planned, we agreed on deliveries and drop-off points. He even had a name for the new Arena format: you guessed it, "The Labyrinth"! I don't know what it had to do with these cellars. So, after that, Ref suddenly canceled everything, said that it wasn't up to him, and disappeared from the radar for a while.

It was hard to give up such a good deal. However, I still have those keycards, I even wanted to stop by sometime to see the arena with my own eyes. There's not many of them, but for you, I'll make a good deal. No haggling though!
sources.67a096fe972c11a3f5077321 successMessageT:
You turned out to be a real dark horse... The results are remarkable. Not everyone can pull this off. 

I'll unlock one of the keycard stashes for you. But be aware that this is a very special item, and I'm not going to give it to you for free.

One more thing. Arena rewards the best gladiators, and you clearly have potential. If you get tired of scavenging the ruins and want real glory, you know where to find me.
sources.67a0970744893b9f3f0d9b68 successMessageT:
An old bunker? Yes, there was one mentioned in the archives, an old Soviet shelter. Thing is, it was closed down about twenty years ago due to some kind of technical failure. Looks like Knossos restored it to working order. But why would TerraGroup need an abandoned bomb shelter? 

Um, hang on. I'm picking up a signal from my interception network. An encrypted message that seems to be coming straight from these cellars... Give me a minute.
sources.67a0970f05d1611ed90be75d successMessageT:
Well done. The data is fragmented, but still extremely useful. The health resort's basements have changed a lot since the disaster began, but at some point in time, they were definitely used as a testing ground for some kind of weapon... An experimental EW or hacking device, maybe. This remains to be determined.

I can already see that some of the measurements and experiments will be very useful in their own right. So your labors were definitely not in vain. Thank you.
sources.67a09724972c11a3f5077324 successMessageT: Great job, my friend! My partner especially appreciates your respect for privacy and requested a proper reward for you.
sources.67a0972e77dd677f600804bd successMessageT:
A video tape... You haven't watched it yet, have you? Now I know what is happening. I was wrong before.

The resort was one of the evacuation points when it all started, and its cellars could have been used for, uh, different purposes... The situation wasn't so severe yet at that time, and they tried to isolate the deceased bodies from crowded places.

This tape is definitely not a cause for concern... However, I would refrain from visiting these cellars if I were you. Ventilation in bomb shelters has always been a weak point, and humidity only contributes to possible intoxication...
sources.67a097379f2068e74603c6ac successMessageT:
I knew I bet on the right guy! So, all safe and sound, ye? Good for you, good for you... Word's already out about your feat, no one's gonna blabber any bullshit to me anymore.

Surely a lasting impression. You helped my business today, so I won't disappoint you either. Here, all yours.
sources.67a0975992ad467b1906d468 successMessageT: Good thing I asked you to do this. Alrighty then, I'll pass it on to my guys. If we're lucky, we'll be swimming in tech sales for a long time. Here's your share, Ragman always rewards good deeds!
sources.67a09761e720611a6a01f288 successMessageT:
Perhaps now you've saved Tarkov from a new calamity that could have wiped the city off the face of the earth... before its time.

Your reward is here. Oh, and one more thing. If I were you, I'd stop enquiring about those dungeons if you want to survive these troubled times.
sources.67a09761e720611a6a01f288 acceptPlayerMes: I didn't think I'd be part of some ritual... Well, I'll figure it out when I get there.
sources.67a09761e720611a6a01f288 completePlayerM: It's done. Your friends are gonna love this.
sources.67af4c1405c58dc6f7056667 successMessageT:
Quite an expensive investment, but my hunch never fails. When we get Luka's squad ready, you'll be so rich you won't be short or anything!

I'll take care of the transfer across the cordon.

The lads gave me the contact of a local spetsnaz instructor. He's retired, but he knows things they didn't tell you in your basic training, I can guarantee that. He'll make a real terminator out of you. Consider it a bonus from our partnership.
sources.67af4c169d95ad16e004fd86 successMessageT:
Beautiful. It's not easy to get a shipment like this across the cordon, but I'll think of something. We're gonna need a proper channel of communication when the dividends come in from the other side. In the meantime, you go see your coach.

You already packed a punch before, and now you're like Bruce Lee! I think we got a real expert instructor, let me tell you.
sources.67af4c17f4f1fb58a907f8f6 successMessageT:
Even got the knives, impressive. I've already found a trusty bloke on the cordon who's gonna handle our deliveries. 

He's not asking for anything yet, but he'll surely put a premium on it later. It's a hell of a lot of work to get supplies to the mainland, you know.
sources.67af4c1991ee75c6d7060a16 successMessageT:
I don't know if I've ever seen such a pile of combat drugs before. Surely that's enough for our lads. And to make you less addicted to this bullshit, I got you a little something. 

My men were cleaning out a spot the other day and they found a cache of medical supplies. There's a bunch of medical books and manuals, with notes and drawings all over them. My medics took a closer look, said the author of these scribblings is a real pro. 

Here, why don't you study it while we wait for the next message from Luka.
sources.67af4c1a6c3ebfd8e6034916 successMessageT:
All right, get your stash ready. You'd better get another bunker for yourself, with this much of imminent income! Now everything's gonna go smoothly. 

If you had doubts, better stop it, for fuck's sake! Our money's on its way. And when you get it, you'll be on another level.
sources.67af4c1cc0e59d55e2010b97 successMessageT: This way... Fucking this way, you dumb fuck! Come sit by if you want to take a swig too. I'll tell you the shit I've been through in my life... Perhaps it'll save you from the same fucking miserable fate.
sources.67af4c1d8c9482eca103e477 successMessageT:
While you were in the lab, I've come up with a reward for you. You're into this whole skill learning thing, right?

I got a mate who used to work for Ref, he was an armorer or something. Here's his contact, tell him I sent you. Talk to him, he'll give you some good advice on guns. 

It won't bring you back the money you lost, but it could save your life in the future. And that's worth more than gear and cash.
sources.67b45467814ab0ffa000c7e7 successMessageT:
Yup, I've heard about your combat exploits. In your hands, the RShG will only do you good, believe me. So, like I said, it's a one-of-a-kind item, but I can manage to put aside a piece per restock for you. 

When you're using it, make sure there's plenty of room and no one stands behind you. And read through the manual on the tube, don't be a jackass.
sources.67b5be6c080431c729082b97 successMessageT:
So, what do you think of these nades? I wouldn't risk usem them myself, the delay's too short for me. Could easily lose an arm with one of those, or even worse. There's already talk of your deeds in the city, which means our message has been heard.

I hope it will calm the hotheads and help those who question human values to come to their senses. They won't thank us for this, but they can at least live to see a time of peace.
sources.67d03be712fb5f8fd2096332 successMessageT: Good thing I asked you to do this. Alrighty then, I'll pass it on to my guys. If we're lucky, we'll be swimming in tech sales for a long time. Here's your share, Ragman always rewards good deeds!
sources.67dd4a2293c5a2d9cf0576b8 successMessageT: This is what true fury is all about! You've set an example for a lot of fighters, and you've brought the crowd back to the Arena. I see the stimulants are working well.
sources.67dd4dcb93c5a2d9cf0576cc successMessageT: Now do you know what I'm talking about? You know the real rage? That's right! The audience is already talking about you like a berserker who knows no fear. So, you've earned your reward.
sources.67dd51f7ea43a622d0016479 successMessageT:
You certainly know how to make a commotion! Here's the gift from the Minotaur, make sure you don't get lost in his labyrinth! Come back again, the Arena audience appreciates you more than the bums in the Tarkov ruins. 
One more thing, you gotta understand that those keycards are a very unique and rare commodity, so I'll give them to you only after you do some of my harder side jobs. Check your list tomorrow, I'll make sure to include them in your reward list.
sources.67dd5d2231fb19ec9408894a successMessageT: There really is something about you...  If you survive your encounter with my acquaintance, do come back to the Arena. In Tarkov, you'll never receive a fraction of what you have here, in the Arena. So long, gladiator.
sources.67e993b1ac26bf29380a320b failMessageText: So why even come to me in the first place if you're just going to give the intel to one of those two?
sources.67e993b1ac26bf29380a320b successMessageT: I'm glad you understand who it's more advantageous to be friends with.
sources.67e993b1ac26bf29380a320b completePlayerM: Here's all I could find on Ref.
sources.67e993f5ed537409f009da75 successMessageT: All right, you've earned your reward. But you better know I'm not gonna take any more of your bullshit. You start digging again, you'll end up like that old champion.
sources.67f3ea581cd4c15d3d040305 successMessageT:
Good work. I went there myself as well and showed them where the marauder's path leads.

I don't like all this sudden new activity. I got a feeling this is just the beginning of some big operation or some kind of gang war. Stay in touch, kid.
sources.67f3ea78c54fde6cc2004855 successMessageT:
Hm, so it is Skier. With him in charge of this program, it is only going to hurt the population. Slimy, as always...

These records need to be studied further, however I will still need your help later. We must thwart Skier's plans, whatever they may be.
sources.67f3ea873daf3aaf3e0e7ff5 successMessageT: This is a great accomplishment. Skier is currently still ahead of us, but once we've set up our food distribution points, we'll be able to pull in at least some of the potential hires. I'll try to offer them alternative employment that will benefit my clie-- My clinic, I mean.
sources.67f3eaa3a7799274d50a8b66 successMessageT:
You cleared all the spots? Good. Let's see how it affects the overall situation. For now, I'm waiting to hear from Partisan, he's still out scouting.

Come back later, it's best not to make any unnecessary moves right now.
sources.67f3eab9a33cd296b20ee695 failMessageText: Wait, so you're the one who's doing Jaeger's fucking mission? What, doing threesome tea parties with Partisan too? Go to your fucking woods all together then, don't bother showing up here again! Don't meddle with my business, you'll fucking regret it, got it?!
sources.67f3eab9a33cd296b20ee695 successMessageT:
Fucking blimey! That fucker's been an annoyance to everyone for a long while. Now we least we have safe places to bring in volunteers. 

I've also done some secret spy shit, so nobody's gonna find my bases now.

Good job, mister operator.
sources.67f3eacef649e7bceb0bb455 failMessageText:
What brings you here? Have you seen Partisan by any chance? He was supposed to show up half an hour ago... He would never be late, it's not good. There are still too many bandits out there!

You better leave now, I'm not in the mood. I've got a friend to help, and you seem to be nothing but trouble.
sources.67f3eacef649e7bceb0bb455 successMessageT:
So, what do you think of these grenades? I wouldn't risk using one, the delay's too short for my reflexes. Thugs are already talking about your endeavors, which means our message has been heard loud and clear.

I hope it will cool their tempers and help those who question human values. They won't thank us, but they can live to see better days.

And for you, I have a special gift. Prapor passed it on. Use it wisely and stay safe.
sources.6834145ebc1f443d7603c8a7 successMessageT: All done? I'll pass it on then. Here are some goodies in the meantime.
sources.6834158f2f0e2a7eb90b62c8 successMessageT: Everything you brought has already been sent to the seats. Well done.
sources.68341846186efa3c5b07f989 successMessageT:
Not a bad gun, eh? Truth be told, I have a soft spot for bullpups. The AUG is obviously difficult to maintain, it has a weird trigger mechanism, hard to get used to, plus it's easy to forget about the ejection port side. Certainly not an amateur's gun. But it feeks so good though! I'd rather not give it to the cleanup crew. 

Anyway, here's your reward.
sources.68341a0b2f0e2a7eb90b62d4 successMessageT:
Alive? Good! What, the armor's shit and doesn't hold against anything? Well shit, that's a shame. It'll be too weak for the cleanup crew, so I'll have to find a better model.

Here's your reward. Let's finish with this balancing thing for now.
sources.68341b407559f4e6d50bc0ce successMessageT: Just what I needed! Not much more to go. Everyone will be thrilled when they see the results, I promise! Here's a helmet as a reward. His last owner has a better one now, ha!
sources.68341c4babec72d95d0c1260 successMessageT: Ha, you should have seen the chaos when they found the bricks! What a show! It's a damn shame we didn't film the whole thing... You did a good job. Here's your reward.
sources.68341d7d7559f4e6d50bc0db failMessageText: Can't you see who you're shooting at?! I had such high hopes for you.
sources.68341d7d7559f4e6d50bc0db successMessageT:
Good work! Kaban and Kollontay are already kicking up a storm. I think soon enough they'll come to me trying to leave this business.

Here's your well deserved reward.
sources.68341eb25619c8e2a9031501 successMessageT: I never doubted you for a second, brother! But remember, we're here to entertain people. We need a bigger show! Sometimes it looks like you're just shooting cans, you know.
sources.68341f6fe2e7ef70a3060a0a successMessageT: I see the progress you're making! They're starting to talk about you overseas. People are interested. It's a sign that you're doing the right thing!
sources.6834202a186efa3c5b07f9a2 successMessageT: And now you're one step closer to the big leagues! Respect, brother.
sources.683421515619c8e2a9031511 failMessageText: Oh man, you almost did it. Try again, the audience still seems to favor you.

sources.68342265a8d674b5740b31f0 successMessageT: You're really good. A very famous French man — I won't tell you his name for privacy — is interested in you. Lispy as hell, but he's offering good money. I've already arranged for your sponsorship.
sources.6834233fecd5cf3a440d855b successMessageT: You want to ask Ref yourself? Well, it was nice knowing you.
sources.68342446a8d674b5740b31fc successMessageT: There you go! Time should be spent improving your skills. Who knows what happens if you don't?

You already have the blueprint with the main rifle body, and you can get the missing parts from me in the future. And yes, drop by my place after you've tested this beast. I plan to send word to my friend and tell him what his creation can do in the field.

I'll tell my boys, they'll drop your part off at the transfer point.

He's got something I need, something of great value to our operation. I need you to track him down and ensure he doesn't leave alive. We can't let him out of our sight. This mission could be the key to unraveling the secrets TerraGroup holds, secrets that could change the course of history.
sources.6741d6176c4b417a408d290f acceptPlayerMes: Good news, and bad news. I'll rip off the bandage and give you the bad news first - Sanitar is still alive. The good news is, one of his guards was captured and sang like we were filming a musical. That fucking "janitor" is returning to his cottage.

sources.6741d74a7ca8a4abfdf908c6 startedMessageT: Operator, great news. Word has spread around Tarkov that you've eliminated Sanitar, and as a result, his rats have started to dig out his stashes. Go ahead and mark it - I'll send some of my boys at night. Another small request. I've been told his henchmen who were with him are dead. I need confirmation. Head to that RUAF outpost at the nature reserve - there should be a white cargo container filled with body bags. Find it, confirm the kills, and get out. Let's not make it too messy.
sources.6741d74a7ca8a4abfdf908c6 successMessageT: Very well Operator. I shall inform the others. For now, wait for another call.

sources.6741d86720827d719dafa146 acceptPlayerMes: Operator, word is spreading that the bloodhounds, led by a certain 'Den' and his scav companion 'Ryzhy,' have infiltrated the Tarkov district. We're tasked with sending a message by eliminating three of the Bloodhounds as a warning, but be cautious not to harm Den; he holds a close connection to Jaeger. And could be helpful in the near future..

sources.6741dbba9e6d28c8ff0a700f startedMessageT: Pal, let me tell you about this little adventure ahead of us. Our message to the Bloodhounds was received. There was a set-up in a deal conducted between a group of rogue PMCs - they played dirty tricks on the Bloodhound's dealers. That's why they made their presence known. We've been tasked with finding out what the deal was, as Den didn't say too much. I think the deal was related to a keycard belonging to TerraGroup. I want you to go and look after that. Bring me a lab access keycard.
